newsitem.title: GERMANY: HORSE RACING-SCHUTZ BOWS OUT OF GERMAN DERBY WITH A WINNER.
newsitem.headline: HORSE RACING-SCHUTZ BOWS OUT OF GERMAN DERBY WITH A WINNER.

text.p: Bruno Schutz, in his last season as a trainer, saddled the filly Borgia to win the German Derby on Sunday.
Borgia, a 7-1 chance ridden by French champion Olivier Peslier, had previously been second in the German Oaks.
Borgia, one of five Schutz runners in the classic, pipped Baroon, the mount of English-based Kieren Fallon, by a neck in the mile and a half (2.4 km) race.
Happy Change, ridden by Epsom Derby winning jockey Willie Ryan, was a further two and a half lengths back in third, with Caitano doing best of the other Schutz runners in fourth.
The Irish colt, Zafarbad, finished best of the three foreign raiders, coming home fifth of the 20 runners.
